name: cambo
description: Cambo is a modern Latin typeface inspired by the contrast, style and ornaments of Khmer typefaces and writing styles. Its main objective is to be used to write Latin texts in a Khmer context, but it is also an elegant choice for all kinds of texts. Designed by Carolina Giovagnoli and Andrés Torresi for Huerta Tipográfica .
